title: Coherent depth-two model of a finite locally free module on an affine open
statement:
theorem exists_affine_depth_two_locally_free_model
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
        (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x) ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x))
    (P : W.toScheme.Modules) [P.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∃ H : (Spec A).Modules,
      H.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      (∀ V : (Spec A).Opens, IsAffineOpen V →
        Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.obj (op V)) (H.val.obj (op V))) ∧
      (∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W →
        ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) H.val.presheaf x),
          letI := hfinite
          (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) H.val.presheaf x)) ∧
      Nonempty (Modules.restrict H W.ι ≅ P)

proof.text: Extend the finitely presented module P across the quasi-compact open W by applying [lem-weil-pbc-module-finite-presentation-extension] to the zero ambient module and zero map. The affine scheme is qcqs, and Noetherianity makes W quasi-compact. Identify the resulting finitely presented sheaf with the tilde of its finite A-module M of global sections.

Form D = Hom_A(Hom_A(M,A),A) and H = tilde D. Noetherianity makes both duals finite. Localization commutes with Hom of finite presentations, so H restricted to W is the double dual of P, hence P because P is finite locally free. These are existential proof witnesses, never chosen as data of a definition.

Dualize a finite free presentation of the first dual to realize D as a kernel between finite free modules. At a boundary stalk choose a regular pair x,y in the base ring. Multiplication by x is injective on the kernel. If y*n=x*nprime, regularity in the free source gives n=x*m; cancellation of x in the free target gives d(m)=0. Thus y is injective on the kernel modulo x. Nakayama gives properness for nonzero finite stalks; zero stalks have infinite depth. This proves the asserted depth bound and Noetherianity gives finite sections on affine opens and finite stalks. Empty W uses the zero model; W=top has no boundary conditions.
